blocks.text: Wayscriber is the managed Wayland annotation overlay. Its Waybar popup can open the overlay, use read-only or freeze modes, show or hide it, toggle light drawing, and display session information.

The daemon is owned by the user session. The toggle helper checks the Wayland socket and service identity before sending one bounded request. An uncertain response is reported without an automatic retry, so inspect the overlay before selecting the action again.

Open config from the Wayscriber menu to edit the user-owned configuration through the managed terminal. Keep the configuration under ~/.config/wayscriber and close the editor before changing overlay modes.

Normal annotation receives drawing input. Read-only uses the light passthrough overlay so input reaches the application below; freeze is a separate mode. Show / hide and Toggle light drawing are distinct operations. Use Session information to review the current state before clearing saved session or tool settings.

Settings → Open config uses the managed terminal editor for ~/.config/wayscriber/config.toml. The [tray] icon_style value is colored in the shipped configuration. Inline # comments outside strings are valid TOML. Tray style changes take effect after restarting the daemon. Save annotations and close the editor before deliberately restarting the owning wayscriber.service user service; Help never restarts it for you.
